text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On New Year's day, Rice Shower invites
me to
visit a shrine with her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Brother. I've decided what to pray
for.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Sister. I've decided what to pray
for.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Can I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yes. This is something I have to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yes. This is something I have to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to race in the spring Tenno Sho
next.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Because I want to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho... is a race all
stayers dream
of... right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That means it's a place... where lots of
great
racers gather.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little scared, but I have to push
through. I
have to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: For both my sake... and Bourbon's.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I've always wanted to become a
blue rose
that brings happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But just saying it isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I want to stop bringing sadness to the
people
around me, then I should do
something about it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
One day, I'll have to run the ultimate
race as
Bourbon's rival.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I need to be strong enough to pull
off a
miracle—to make the impossible
possible.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Rice is going to race in the spring
Tenno Sho,
then she has to get used to
races of the same
length first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For now, we'll set our sights on the
2500-meter
turf Nikkei Sho in the
spring. As for our goal...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You got it!
choice_data_list: 『日経賞』では必ず3着以内になろう！

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we have a new goal for the
new year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To make the most of her enthusiasm, she
decides
to write out her New Year's
resolution on a
wooden prayer tablet.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I'm going to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Me too! I'm so glad we came here!
choice_data_list: いい願い事が書けたな
いい願い事が書けたね

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Me too! I'm so glad we came here!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, now it's your turn.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, now it's your turn.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll wish with you. I'm sure it'll be
granted.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, I also want Bourbon's injury to
heal
quickly.
choice_data_list: みんな元気になりますように
ライスの走りを支え続けたい

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: ライスも元気でいてほしい

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Understood. Well, I don't want to
make
you worry, so I'll be careful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We fill up on nutrients at the nearby
food stalls
before we go and start
training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I don't know how to respond
when you say
something so nice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... But I don't have time to cry. I... have to work hard... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After I comfort Rice Shower for a little
while, we
head off to start training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You want to be stronger, huh? Um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Can I help with that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We can go to the gym together... or do
partner
running...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?
choice_data_list: そういうつもりじゃなかったんだ
そういうつもりじゃなかったの

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if I can do anything to help... let
me know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll do anything I can to help you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll do anything I can to help you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can feel the weight of Rice Shower's

consideration for me the whole way back
to
campus.
